initialize_module_with_kaiming: initialize a PyTorch module's weights using Kaiming initialization with configurable distribution and nonlinearity
initialize_module_with_xavier: initialize a PyTorch module's weights using Xavier initialization with normal or uniform distribution
initialize_module_with_trunc_normal: initialize a PyTorch module's weights using truncated normal distribution with configurable bounds
initialize_module_from_pretrained: initialize a PyTorch module by loading weights from a pretrained checkpoint file with optional prefix
initialize_module_with_override: initialize a PyTorch module with default settings and override specific sub-modules with custom initialization
